notes: Minimum minutes per stop is on Profile. The default is 15 and Reset To 15 puts it back. Day estimates use the higher of the stop time and this setting.
Roll Overflow To Next Week places stops that do not fit onto later open days until each one has a slot. Winterization stops at the season end.
Include Weekends adds Saturday and Sunday to Auto-spread and the overflow roll. The same daily cap applies. It stays off until you turn it on.
Add a customer from pasted text or a screenshot read on the phone. A customer photo stays on the account, compressed.
A screenshot used to fill a new customer is discarded after the text is read. It is not saved on the phone.
